lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, Before you begin: "If you are the beneficiary of a deceased employee or former employee who died before August 21, 1996, include any death benefit exclusion that you are entitled to (up to $5,000) in the amount entered on line 2 below." retirement.special still asks about "a death benefit exclusion" and refuses the entry (retirement.taxable and retirement.rolled), so line 2 is the cost alone on every entry the worksheet reaches. Re-checked against the current forms/2025/retirement.yaml this round: BUG-0393 added the qualified disaster recovery distribution (Form 8915-F) to retirement.special and reworded retirement.rollover and retirement.exception; retirement.special still names "a death benefit exclusion" and "a pension or annuity in which you have after-tax cost whose annuity starting date ... was before November 19, 1996", and the worksheet expressions are unchanged. Same model reading as earlier rounds. Project stands on the English.

Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 5: "If your annuity starting date was before 1987, skip lines 6 and 7 and enter this amount on line 8. Otherwise, go to line 6", and line 10's before-1987 STOP. A starting date before 1987 is before November 19, 1996, which retirement.special refuses for an annuity with after-tax cost, and retirement.annuity asks for a starting date after November 18, 1996. So the post-1986 path of line 8 is the only one reached.
